risk_note: RV2-level (payout account: bank card path and the paid three-factor verification). PUT /v1/me/payout-account goes live (withStepUp + executeInTransaction, keyedRequestDigest); bank card 12–19 digits + Luhn, card BIN port (debit only, bank from BIN), verifier port with local / test fakes only (staging / prod unwired → 50301, no forged vendor messages). Reservation in a short transaction under the users row lock (FOR NO KEY UPDATE): same key (fingerprint compared first, a different card → 20901) → same fingerprint → daily quota (+08:00, released not counted); provider outside the lock with a 10 s bound; matched saved with the account in the claim transaction, mismatched 30307, unknown 50401 in its own transaction; lease takeover and unknown recheck exported for B1-13g. Contract: bank_name optional and ignored, error codes completed, StepUpToken minLength dropped (missing / empty → 10003 as its description says). Known follow-ups recorded: the blocklist check borrows a second pool connection under the lock; the same-as-current branch runs before the fingerprint comparison (S2). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
